mapper.select: SELECT id AS patientId, name, sex, pid, tel, birthday, medical_history AS medicalHistory, allergy_history AS allergyHistory, family_history AS familyHistory, insurance_type AS insuranceType FROM patient_user_info WHERE id = #{patientId}

SELECT mrd.id AS medicalRecordId, mrd.registration_id AS registrationId, reg.date AS visitDate, reg.slot AS slot, md.name AS department, mds.name AS deptSubName, d.name AS doctorName, mrd.chief_complaint AS chiefComplaint, mrd.present_illness AS presentIllness, mrd.physical_exam AS physicalExam, mrd.diagnosis AS diagnosis, mrd.doctor_advice AS doctorAdvice, mrd.remark AS remark FROM medical_record mrd LEFT JOIN medical_registration reg ON mrd.registration_id = reg.id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON mrd.doctor_id = d.id LEFT JOIN medical_dept_sub mds ON mrd.dept_sub_id = mds.id LEFT JOIN medical_dept md ON mds.dept_id = md.id WHERE mrd.patient_id = #{patientId} AND mrd.id = #{medicalRecordId} LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id AS prescriptionId, p.medical_record_id AS medicalRecordId, p.type AS type, p.status AS status, p.create_time AS createTime, reg.id AS registrationId, reg.date AS visitDate, reg.slot AS slot, md.name AS department, mds.name AS deptSubName, d.name AS doctorName, mrd.diagnosis AS diagnosis, mrd.doctor_advice AS doctorAdvice FROM prescription p LEFT JOIN medical_record mrd ON p.medical_record_id = mrd.id LEFT JOIN medical_registration reg ON mrd.registration_id = reg.id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON p.doctor_id = d.id LEFT JOIN medical_dept_sub mds ON mrd.dept_sub_id = mds.id LEFT JOIN medical_dept md ON mds.dept_id = md.id WHERE p.patient_id = #{patientId} AND p.id = #{prescriptionId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id AS id, prescription_id AS prescriptionId, drug_name AS drugName, specification AS specification, quantity AS quantity, dosage AS dosage, frequency AS frequency, days AS days, remark AS remark FROM prescription_item WHERE prescription_id = #{prescriptionId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO patient_user_info (uuid, name, sex, pid, tel, birthday, password, medical_history, allergy_history, family_history, insurance_type) VALUES (#{uuid}, #{name}, #{sex}, #{pid}, #{tel}, #{birthday}, #{password}, #{medicalHistory}, #{allergyHistory}, #{familyHistory}, #{insuranceType})
mapper.select: SELECT id, uuid, name, sex, pid, tel, birthday, password, medical_history AS medicalHistory, allergy_history AS allergyHistory, family_history AS familyHistory, insurance_type AS insuranceType, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM patient_user_info WHERE tel = #{tel} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE medical_registration SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
